item.tib: bon skyongs srung ma'i 'phrin bcol smon pa yongs 'grub
item.coloph: smras pa/ bstan pa'i snying po sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon/ bstan srung srid pa'i rgyal mo 'khor bcas la/ bstan pa srung phyir 'phrin las bcol ba'i thabs/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i pad tshal zhes bya ba/ mi dbang phun tshogs bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis/ yang yang bskul ngor sman ri'i bla ming pa/ nyi ri shel bzhin bya bas gser 'phyang gi nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por bris/ sdeb nyes lung 'gal nor 'khrul ci mchis pa/ rtsa gsum lha dang bka' skyongs tshogs la bshags/ dge tshogs ci mchis mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo/ myur du rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
